title: REPORT on the control of the financial activities of the European Investment Bank – annual report 2023
part_text: 85. Is alarmed by the situation of Northvolt AB, a battery manufacturer considered pivotal in the green transition; stresses that Northvolt has benefited from a substantial EIB lending package of slightly over EUR 942.6 million as part of the debt financing to expand a gigafactory site; notes that Northvolt filed for bankruptcy in March 2025; calls on the EIB to provide details about the evaluation and decision-making process to fund Northvolt AB and the causes that led to the failure of the project; calls for a full examination and evaluation of potential losses to taxpayers from green projects such as Northvolt; calls for an internal risk and conflict of interest assessment, including of senior EIB officials with political connections to certain green projects such as Northvolt, to be carried out without delay;
